range_semantics.unversioned_ci_policy: An install in portable CI proves API execution but does not justify widening an exact distribution range unless that run also records the resolved distribution version.
range_semantics.range_expansion_policy: A dependency range is widened only after the candidate executes the relevant API probes at the new boundary. Exact-patch intervals below are deliberate where only one exact version is currently captured.

selection_contract.mapping_rule: Every Python import and distribution version must be resolved by the same selected interpreter; import-module and distribution names are distinct typed fields and may not be inferred from one another.

rogo_host_validation.reason: No version receipt from the current Rogo installed host is present in this repository. These ranges are a local/portable-CI candidate contract, not a claim that Rogo is already compatible.
